# KeyEventKind

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Input` · enum

```csharp
public enum KeyEventKind
```

The state transition represented by a [`KeyEvent`](KeyEvent.md).

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="pressed"></a>`Pressed` | The key transitioned to the down state (or fired an OS auto-repeat while still held, in which case [`KeyEvent.IsRepeat`](KeyEvent.md#isrepeat) is `true`). |
| <a name="released"></a>`Released` | The key transitioned to the up state. |
